headline: Clean: the missing Green-checking boost and the multi-product relationship bonus are both documented, and the $33.00 correction follows directly.
solution_check: Silver $144,000 is in the >= $10,000 tier at 4.0% (silver_account_003). Green checking + Silver is pairing 11 (doc_012) with a boost of +0.25% (green_account_(checking)_001). The customer holds two products, which earns the 0.025% relationship bonus (silver_account_002/005), and has no credit cards. Expected APY is 4.275%. Actual is 480 x 12 / 144000 = 4.0%. Difference: 144000 x 0.275% / 12 = $33.00. This matches gold[6] (credit 33.00) and gold[8] (expected 4.275, actual 4.0).
prior_note: The prior review also rated this task clean.
notes: Grading-model bullets confirmed against the v1.0.1 snapshot. Both apply_savings_account_credit_6831 and submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294 cast amounts with float(), and record ids embed f'{amount}' / f'{expected_apy}', so 33 and 33.0 hash identically, but any difference in value (even one cent) changes the hash. Gold read get_bank_account_transactions_9173 and get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 are allowlisted, so skipping either changes the hash. Monthly interest convention: the posted credits equal balance x APY / 12 exactly (simple, not daily-compounded), so the agent can infer the convention from the data. silver_account_002 says the customer 'may also qualify' for the relationship bonus. The FAQ (silver_account_005) and docs 043/044 ('Missing Relationship Bonus: Customer maintains multiple Rho-Bank products') make inclusion the clear reading. This task's gold includes the bonus, which is the opposite of task_097's Silver gold (see that finding). Replay: dropping the gold get_bank_account_transactions_9173 read changes the hash, but the read is natural (doc_043/044 require it).
